name: stifling-trap-memory-alt-cost-not-offered-without-a-target-ally
notes: Stifling Trap's Class Bonus alternate cost with no ally on either field to target (the opponent's Dungeon Guide is still on the stack): the memory copy is not offered, so the two preparation counters are not spent on an activation that could do nothing.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Stifling Trap ('deal 2 damage to target ally') had no legal-target check, so its Class Bonus alternate cost (remove two preparation counters, activate from memory) was offered, and paid, with no ally anywhere to target. Fix: CanUseStiflingTrapMemoryActivation() requires at least one ally on either field.
